one_line: An educational ad demonstrating how chin position alters the perceived size of the nose using visual data and interactive exercises.

hook.what_happens: A split-screen face comparison asks if the viewer's nose is too big, revealing it is the same nose in both images.
hook.why_it_works: Challenges immediate visual perception and introduces a surprising counter-intuitive fact.

transcript.text: Think your nose is too big?
Same face. Same nose. Same woman, twice.
Same nose, both photographs.
But it looks smaller in the second.
Her chin is what moved.
Here is every pixel that changed.
Almost none of it is on her nose.
Your eye doesn't measure features.
It compares them.
When the chin sits back, the nose stands out.
Your brain calls it a big nose.
Bring it forward and the nose has something to sit against.
It didn't shrink. The face caught up.
Try it right now.
Push your lower jaw forward.
Your nose just got smaller. You didn't touch it.
The question was never which feature to fix.
It's what the whole face does when one thing moves.
See it on your own face first.
A preview, not a promise.
Search Refina AI.

narrative_arc: Hook: Challenge the viewer's perception of their nose size.
Evidence: Show that chin adjustments alter nose perception using pixel data.
Theory: Explain the cognitive science of facial feature comparison.
Interactive test: Have the viewer physically test the theory on themselves.
Conclusion: Reframe facial aesthetics as holistic rather than feature-isolated.
CTA: Direct viewers to try the AI preview tool.

cta.what: Search Refina AI to preview changes on your own face.

what_makes_it_work: Scientific framing using data visualization (pixel charts) builds high credibility.
The interactive 'try it now' physical exercise immediately proves the ad's premise to the viewer.

animation_language_summary.how_things_enter: Elements fade and scale up smoothly or slide in from edges.
animation_language_summary.how_things_leave: Hard cuts transition scenes instantly without exit animations.
animation_language_summary.how_scenes_change: Abrupt cuts divide major conceptual beats.
animation_language_summary.what_stays_still: The central portrait alignment and background color remain constant.
animation_language_summary.rhythm: Bursty, alternating between static analytical frames and fluid motion sweeps.

what_we_should_steal: ConvergePanels for dramatic split-screen merging effects
AnimateBarChart for clean, engaging data visualization
